question: What Are the Types of Thermowells?
body_html:
Types of thermowells fall into two families: bar stock, machined from one solid bar, and fabricated, welded from a tube and solid tip. Both offer threaded, flanged or weld in connections.

TypeKey FeatureTypical Use
Bar stock threadedScrews into the processSmall lines, low to medium pressure
Bar stock flangedLeak proof flange jointSensor removal needed
Bar stock weld inPermanent, vibration resistantHigh pressure, high temperature
FabricatedLighter and more economicalLess severe service
Van StoneLoose flange, easy removalFrequent maintenance
